subject: Remittance subject token guidance — portal preferred, SMTP fallback
messages:
From: Leah Kaplan <leah@silverpine.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@silverpine.co
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — invoicing channel and subject line format question

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the onboarding link — attaching our completed vendor form (vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf). A couple of items came up while we prepared the AP team for Redwood: 

1) Channel: do you prefer invoices uploaded to the portal as the primary method and email as a fallback? If email, what is the canonical address we should send to?

2) Subject / token: our AP system relies on a PO token in the email subject so we can auto-route (e.g., PO123456). Does Redwood require any specific prefix/suffix? Any preferred delimiter if an invoice references multiple POs?

3) Template: do you accept a single PDF with multiple POs on separate invoice lines, or do you require one invoice per PO for portal ingestion? Formats we can export: PDF (single or per-PO), CSV (line-item), or an OCR-friendly PDF.

I attached a sample invoice (sample-invoice-multi-po.pdf) to show how our billing typically looks. If there is a template CSV example you prefer, can you share that?

Goal: get this set up this week so our next billing cycle can go through the right path.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Leah Kaplan
Finance Manager, Silverpine Logistics
leah@silverpine.co
+1 415-555-0126

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (application/pdf), sample-invoice-multi-po.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Kaplan <leah@silverpine.co>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Apr 2028 10:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — invoicing channel and subject line format question

Hi Leah — great to hear from you and thanks for the completed form. Short answers up front, then details: portal preferred; email fallback to invoices@redwoodinference.com; subject token format below. Attaching a CSV example that our payments engine ingests (invoice_template_csv_example.csv).

Portal vs Email
- Preferred: Portal upload (portal gives faster ACK and auto-match).
- Fallback: SMTP to invoices@redwoodinference.com (we run an ingestion pipeline that reads subject tokens + attachment).

Subject token (required for email fallback):
- Use: RedwoodPO:<PO_NUMBER> INV:<VENDOR_INV_NO>
- Example: "RedwoodPO:PO-123456 INV:SP-20280401"
- Multiple POs on one invoice: separate POs with semicolons ("RedwoodPO:PO-123456;PO-123457 INV:SP-20280401"). We prefer semicolons rather than pipes to avoid parsing issues.

Attachment rules and formats
- Portal: single PDF is fine; prefer one invoice per file for highest automation rates, but portal supports multi-PO PDFs if line items clearly map to POs.
- Email: CSV (line-item) or single PDF per invoice works. If sending a PDF with multiple POs, include the semicolon-separated PO list in the subject token.

Remittance / Sensitive info
- Do not put bank credentials in the subject or file name. Include remittance bank info only inside the invoice body or in a secured portal field.

Next steps
- I attached our CSV example which maps line items to PO columns.
- Jordan (cc'd) will confirm if we can accept a consolidated monthly invoice for multiple POs (short answer: possible but will require PO-level line items).

If you want, we can run a one-off test: send the same invoice via portal and via SMTP to invoices@redwoodinference.com so our ops team can confirm parsing.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Partner Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: invoice_template_csv_example.csv (text/csv)

From: Leah Kaplan <leah@silverpine.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Silverpine Logistics AP <accounts@silverpine.co>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2028 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — invoicing channel and subject line format question

Thanks Marissa — that helps. Quick clarifications from our AP team: 

- For multi-PO PDFs: we currently stamp PO numbers in the header as "PO: 123456 / 123457" (forward slash). We'll change to semicolons if that helps parsing. Will the semicolon need spaces? (i.e. "PO-123456;PO-123457" vs "PO-123456; PO-123457")
- Do you want the vendor tax ID somewhere in the subject token for faster reconciliation? We can append last-4 of tax ID as INV suffix (e.g., "INV:SP-20280401-TAX1234").
- For consolidated monthly invoices: if accepted, do you need a separate line that maps each PO to the line items, or can we attach a PO-to-lineitem mapping CSV alongside the PDF?

Attaching our sample invoice (same as before) and a short example of how our system formats multi-PO headers. If you confirm semicolon + no spaces is preferred, we'll update the output in our billing system.

Best,
Leah

Attachments: sample-invoice-multi-po.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Kaplan <leah@silverpine.co>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2028 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — invoicing channel and subject line format question

Leah — thanks for the quick follow-up and the sample. Jordan and I chatted; confirmed guidance below so you can finalize your billing export: 

1) Semicolons: please use semicolons without spaces: "RedwoodPO:PO-123456;PO-123457". That is what our parser expects.
2) Tax ID in subject: optional but helpful. If you include it, please append as "-TAX[last4]" on the invoice token only (example: "RedwoodPO:PO-123456 INV:SP-20280401-TAX1234"). We won't use full tax IDs in subjects for security reasons.
3) Consolidated monthly invoice: allowed with two requirements: (a) include a companion CSV mapping file (PO, line_number, amount) and (b) ensure each CSV row references the PO exactly as in the subject token. Attach the CSV to the same email (or upload both to the portal).
4) Portal test: please run one pilot — upload the PDF + companion CSV to the portal AND send the same set to invoices@redwoodinference.com with the subject token per above. We'll ACK and confirm parsing results within one business day.

I'll update the onboarding form to include the subject token example and the optional tax-last4 field. Vanessa — can you add the semicolon + tax-last4 example to the vendor facing doc we share from the portal?

Leah — if that all looks good I can schedule the pilot for Monday 04/29. Confirm and we'll proceed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Partner Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
